VI.description: Read only. For every VI in memory of the instance this helper runs in (Application\3AAll VIs In Memory with no application reference)\2C open a reference by name and read Modifications\3AFront Panel Mods Bitset and Block Diagram Mods Bitset. One line per VI\3A fp TAB bd TAB error code TAB VI path TAB qualified name - the path (read as VI Path) tells installation code from the user\27s. Nonzero bits = unsaved changes. Used by lvai_vis_in_memory and the memory guard of lvai_restart_labview. Ported unchanged from a LabVIEW skill kit helper measured 2026-10-07 and 2026-10-08 on LabVIEW 2026 Q3 32-bit (419 lines\2C helper error 0)\3B this copy itself is unmeasured.

Node.outputs: Application\3AAll VIs In Memory:4220.vis,reference out:,error out:4220.err
